title: Illinois weighs broadband access against farmland property rights
summary: The legislation aims to clear obstacles for broadband deployment, but agricultural groups argue it could come at the expense of rural property rights.

title: States face data integration challenges as they prepare to verify Medicaid recipients’ education status under H.R. 1
summary: Education data providers, like the National Student Clearinghouse and third-party vendors, are developing ways to connect enrollment records with state eligibility systems, though privacy agreements and existing workflows remain hurdles to implementation.

title: Indiana Secretary of State modernizes business services platform under departing CIO
summary: Robert Fulk's last major modernization initiative as Indiana Secretary of State CIO was overhauling the state’s INBiz business portal.

title: New York’s RAISE Act 2.0 would expand AI oversight, according to safety expert
summary: A second version of the state’s AI safety legislation would give regulators more authority to scrutinize model development, require independent audits and potentially limit computing resources used by AI companies.

title: Maryland unveils new strategy, builds technical acquisition team to overhaul state IT procurement
summary: Maryland’s new statewide tech acquisition initiative is focused on validating agency needs, simplifying procurement and delivering useful technology sooner.

title: Oklahoma expands public access to state spending data with new transparency database
summary: The new tool consolidates state purchasing information, allowing residents and lawmakers to search agency purchases, vendors and transaction amounts.

title: Nebraska CIO Matthew McCarville announces resignation
summary: The state’s top technology official is departing after more than two years overseeing modernization and cybersecurity initiatives.

title: State CIOs support election technology, but secretaries of state often manage the systems
summary: While secretaries of state often maintain their own election technology infrastructure, state CIOs provide support for cybersecurity, network capacity and incident response.

title: Data sharing could help states better align Medicaid and public health efforts, report finds
summary: The report highlights how stronger data-sharing partnerships between Medicaid and public health agencies could help states better identify health needs and fine tune intervention strategies.

title: Center for Civic Futures awards grant to Nava Labs to help modernize state benefits technology with AI
summary: The latest award through the organization’s Public Benefit Innovation Fund will support the use of artificial intelligence tools to help agencies update aging Medicaid and SNAP systems.
